title: geranium viscosissimum var. incisum
intro: Geranium viscosissimum var. incisum, commonly known as Sticky Geranium or Cut-leaved Geranium, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, anxiolytic, and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of Geranium viscosissimum var. incisum include geraniin, a polyphenol compound, as well as other flavonoids and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
